(sec-module-symbolics.solvers)=
# Module: symbolics.solvers

The solvers of the systems of exudyn.symbolics.systemModel (#3112, #3126): SolveExplicit integrates a
SymbolicSystemBase - a SymbolicSystem or a NumpySystem - by explicit Euler, RK44 or velocity Verlet, as
Exudyn's explicit solver does, SolveGeneralizedAlpha by the generalized-alpha method, as Exudyn's implicit
solver does, with ODE1 coordinates and index-3 constraints (#3134); both take the SimulationSettings of
Exudyn, write the solution file and the sensors as SolveDynamic does, and write the state into mbs for a
SymbolicSystem.

- **Author**: Johannes Gerstmayr
- **Date**: 2026-10-26 (created)

(sec-solvers-solveexplicit)=
## Function: SolveExplicit

[`SolveExplicit(system, simulationSettings = None, solverType = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/solvers.py#L161)

- **function description**: the explicit time integration of a SymbolicSystemBase with constant step size, by explicit Euler, RK44 or velocity Verlet, as Exudyn's explicit solver computes them (#3112, design docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md §10): the steps from timeIntegration.startTime, endTime and numberOfSteps; the accelerations by the inverse per body with timeIntegration.explicit.computeMassMatrixInversePerBody, else by the sparse LU decomposition of the mass matrix, both once for a constant mass matrix (timeIntegration.reuseConstantMassMatrix); ODE1 coordinates in the stages of explicit Euler and RK44, with zero initial velocities, as Exudyn (#3134); algebraic equations are refused (Exudyn's explicit solver eliminates only constraints of coordinates on the ground); for a SymbolicSystem the solution file, the sensors and the renderer of its mbs by simulationSettings.solution, as after SolveDynamic
- **input**:
  - `system`: the system, a SymbolicSystemBase
  - `simulationSettings`: exudyn.SimulationSettings; None: the defaults
  - `solverType`: an exudyn.DynamicSolverType of explicitSolverTypes; None: timeIntegration.solverType
- **output**: dict with 'time' (n_out), 'q', 'q_t', 'q_tt' (n_out x nODE2) - with ODE1 coordinates 'y', 'y_t' (n_out x nODE1) - at the steps of solution.file.writePeriod and the last step, and the statistics 'steps', 'forceEvaluations', 'massMatrixEvaluations'


Relevant Examples (Ex) and TestModels (TM) with weblink to github: [`symbolicSystemSpringDamper.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/Examples/symbolicSystemSpringDamper.py) (Ex), [`symbolicExplicitSolverTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicExplicitSolverTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicSystemLoadsTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSystemLoadsTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicSystemODE1AETest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSystemODE1AETest.py) (TM), [`symbolicSystemODE1Test.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSystemODE1Test.py) (TM), [`symbolicUserItemsTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserItemsTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py) (TM)


(sec-solvers-solvegeneralizedalpha)=
## Function: SolveGeneralizedAlpha

[`SolveGeneralizedAlpha(system, simulationSettings = None)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/solvers.py#L250)

- **function description**: the implicit time integration of a SymbolicSystemBase with constant step size by the generalized-alpha method in the form of Arnold and Bruls, as Exudyn's MainSolverImplicitSecondOrder computes it (#3126, #3134, design docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md §6): per step the predictor of the displacements, velocities and algorithmic accelerations, the ODE1 coordinates by the trapezoidal rule, then Newton's method for the accelerations, the ODE1 coordinates and the algebraic coordinates with the residual of SystemResidual - r = M q_tt - f + C_q^T z, g - y_t, c - and its Jacobian, the ODE2 rows scaled by beta h^2 and the algebraic columns by 1/(beta h^2), as Exudyn; by timeIntegration: numberOfSteps, startTime, endTime, generalizedAlpha.spectralRadius, useNewmark with newmarkBeta and newmarkGamma, computeInitialAccelerations - with constraints of [M C_q^T; C_q 0] [q_tt; z] = [f; -(C_q q_t)_q q_t] -, storeInitialAlgebraicCoordinates, and newton.relativeTolerance, absoluteTolerance, maxIterations, useModifiedNewton (the Jacobian once per step) and weightTolerancePerCoordinate; for a SymbolicSystem the solution file, the sensors and the renderer of its mbs, as SolveExplicit. A step whose Newton iteration does not converge raises: the step size is constant. The ODE1 velocities start at zero, as in Exudyn
- **input**:
  - `system`: the system, a SymbolicSystemBase
  - `simulationSettings`: exudyn.SimulationSettings; None: the defaults
- **output**: dict with 'time' (n_out), 'q', 'q_t', 'q_tt' (n_out x nODE2), with ODE1 coordinates 'y', 'y_t', with algebraic equations 'z', at the steps of solution.file.writePeriod and the last step, and the statistics 'steps', 'newtonIterations', 'jacobianEvaluations'


Relevant Examples (Ex) and TestModels (TM) with weblink to github: [`symbolicSystemRigidBodyPendulum.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/Examples/symbolicSystemRigidBodyPendulum.py) (Ex), [`genericDAETest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/genericDAETest.py) (TM), [`symbolicGeneralizedAlphaTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicGeneralizedAlphaTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicSystemItemJacobiansTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSystemItemJacobiansTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicSystemJointsTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSystemJointsTest.py) (TM), [`symbolicSystemODE1AETest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSystemODE1AETest.py) (TM), [`symbolicSystemODE1Test.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicSystemODE1Test.py) (TM), [`symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserRigidBodiesTest.py) (TM)


(sec-solvers--initialaccelerations)=
## Function: _InitialAccelerations

[`_InitialAccelerations(system, q, q_t, y, t, epsilon = 1e-6)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/symbolics/solvers.py#L382)

- **function description**: the initial accelerations and algebraic coordinates of CSolverImplicitSecondOrder: [M C_q^T; C_q 0] [q_tt; z] = [f; -(C_q q_t)_q q_t], the ODE1 rows a unit matrix with zero right-hand side; C_q by central differences of the algebraic equations, (C_q q_t)_q q_t as their second derivative along q_t


(sec-module-symbolics.solvers-class--massmatrixsolver)=
## CLASS _MassMatrixSolver (in module symbolics.solvers)

**class description**: the accelerations a = M^-1 f of a system: by the inverse per body, or by the LU decomposition of M, dense up to _denseMassMatrixSize coordinates, else sparse; the inverse or the decomposition computed once for a constant mass matrix


(sec-module-symbolics.solvers-class--output)=
## CLASS _Output (in module symbolics.solvers)

**class description**: the output of a solver of this module: the states at the steps of solution.file.writePeriod, as CSolverBase writes them - the start, then each time a write period is passed, and the last step -, and for a SymbolicSystem the output through its mbs: an Exudyn solver object, which writes the solution file and the sensors and updates the renderer in FinishStep, by simulationSettings.solution; it runs as explicit Euler without inverse per body, which only decides what its initialization computes
